title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
SEC cancels Reg Crypto vote — CFTC takes lead on digital assets (regulatory framework pivot).
BoJ signals Sep rate hike (Reuters sources) — JPY strength, risk-off headwind for BTC.
BTC ETFs: $131M net outflow Aug 13; two-day total $192M — institutional selling streak.
UAE tankers struck by Iran drones at Hormuz — oil chokepoint escalation continues.
BTC -1.7% / ETH -1.3% / DXY -0.41% / Oil +1.21% — no price thresholds breached.
